draft.subject: A quick hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Nice work getting Orchard Ventures' first project created and an invite out the door already. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually putting real work into that project and getting your teammate in alongside you.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how you'd like Orchard Ventures' work mapped into projects and tasks, and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Chidi
